snippet.title: [GameBoy full game walkthrough] Monster Truck (1990 Varie) FHD 60fps
snippet.description:
Monster Truck
1990 Varie
Recommendations ★★★☆☆
It's a racing game that controls a monster truck. The course consists of a two-lane one-way road that can only be overtaken by hitting the other vehicle or by lifting the front wheel and throwing the other vehicle in front of it. The vehicle is slow, making it difficult to feel the speed, and it can be frustrating that you have to slow down to less than 40km when you cross a hill or obstacle. After clearing the stage, you can speed up by upgrading, but it's still hard to feel that it's getting faster.
